title: French Quesadilla with Chiles
description: A unique fusion of French and Mexican flavors, this quesadilla features seared chiles and melted cheese.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of butter and sear the sliced chiles until caramelized.
In a separate pan, melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Place a quesadilla in the pan and sprinkle with grated cheese, chopped cilantro, and sliced chives.
Fold the quesadilla in half and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
Repeat with the remaining quesadilla and filling ingredients.
Serve the quesadillas hot with crushed red pepper on top.
Garnish with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
